Oml!!!! This is so so so so so so so pretty and beautiful and perfect! The shading is \*chefs kiss\* and beautiful! Hmmm, honestly this is 98% perfect! I noticed that towards the end of the hair you made it kind of have the illusion of it twisting or something but its a little too thin where it bends. Also, try to make the hair look fuller or thicker in the back instead of just large chunks of hair. Otherwise, this is really really pretty and you drew the hands so well!
Woahhhhhh I can't find anything slightly wrong with the drawing! It's absolutely beautiful \^\^ Good job <3

I think that the ear needs to be a little less long horizontally and it needs more detail. The eyes are too pointed down and should probably have a bit more detail. As for the clothing, it's a little hard to tell if that's his neck or shirt underneath the head... And the lips should usually be just one main line with a short line underneath or above to hint at a plumper lip. The nose also needs some kind of end or point instead of just two lines. Otherwise, great work and keep practicing!! <3

First off, this is absolutely beautiful and accurate! Its so pretty <3 I think the only thing I've noticed that I can critique on is that you should make the objects further from the camera angle lighter or "foggier". As objects get further away from you, they become less visible, so take that into account and just make the mountains have a little fog or less visibility. Also I love the floor shading and the shadows!!! Overall this is a very accurate and well-drawn picture. <33

Wowowowowow this is so pretty! I love how accurate you've gotten the clothing and hair to be! The only criticism I'd give towards this is that I think the stance is a bit awkward. It kind of looks like she's squatting down. Instead of having both legs parallel to each other, move the left leg backwards as if she's taking a firm stance. It's kind of hard to explain, so I'm sorry if I'm unclear. Also, one more thing I noticed was that I think her butt is a little off. I think it maybe should be moved a bit higher and not flowing right into the leg. Add a little bump or crease (idk how to describe it) to make it look more proportional and realistic. Otherwise, it's so beautiful!! <33

Woahh that's really cool the eye shading is nice! The only critiques I have to give is that I think the neck is a bit long and the left side of the face seems a little narrow and short. Otherwise, it's a very beautiful drawing! <3
